mapper.select: SELECT h.*, c.childName FROM heat h JOIN child c ON h.childId = c.childId WHERE h.mno = #{mno} AND h.childId = #{childId} ORDER BY h.recordDate DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO heat (childId, mno, temperature, memo, recordDate) VALUES (#{childId}, #{mno}, #{temperature}, #{memo}, DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR))
mapper.update: UPDATE heat SET temperature = #{temperature}, memo = #{memo}, recordDate = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR) WHERE heatNo = #{heatNo}
